answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 47000 Country: India Title: Durood in Salah Question: I want to know as to which durood should be read in salah after attahiyat. I heard that any durood can be read in salah after attahiyat. Answer ID: 47000 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1222/825/L=10/1434) It is right that one may read any durood after al-tahiyat. However, it is good to read durood Ibrahimi. (Shami: 2:222) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
